train_seq2seq_agent: train a Parlai seq2seq agent on convai2 with parlai train_model -m examples/seq2seq
build_encoder_lstm: build an Encoder module with an embedding layer and 1-layer LSTM for encoding input tokens
build_decoder_lstm: build a Decoder module with an embedding layer and 1-layer LSTM supporting incremental decoding
reorder_encoder_states: reorder encoder hidden and cell states by batch indices for beam search generation
reorder_decoder_incremental_state: reorder decoder incremental hidden and cell states by batch indices for efficient generation
